title: A Greek-English Lexicon
author: Henry George Liddell and Robert Scott
scope: The lexicon, pages 1-1774, and the Addenda, pages 1774-1776. The preface, the list of authors and the other front matter are not included.

license.note: The 1901 printing is in the public domain. The OCR text, its corrections and the entry structure are released under CC BY-SA 4.0, like the rest of the Open Greek corpus. Some corrected headwords take their marks, and a few their letters, from LSJ9 as encoded by the Perseus Digital Library (PerseusDL/lexica), which is also released under CC BY-SA 4.0.

attribution: Henry George Liddell and Robert Scott, A Greek-English Lexicon, eighth edition (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1897; printing of 1901). OCR from the University of Toronto copy (Internet Archive), with pages from an undated American Book Company issue and the University of Illinois copies of the 1901 printing (HathiTrust), by the Open Greek project, CC BY-SA 4.0. Some headword breathings, accents, breves, macrons and letters are taken from Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Henry Stuart Jones and Roderick McKenzie, A Greek-English Lexicon, ninth edition (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1940), as encoded by the Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University (http://www.perseus.tufts.edu/; https://github.com/PerseusDL/lexica), CC BY-SA 4.0.

LSJ9 (Liddell, Scott, Jones and McKenzie, A Greek-English Lexicon, ninth edition) in the Perseus Digital Library encoding, files grc.lsj.perseus-eng1.xml to grc.lsj.perseus-eng27.xml: some corrected headwords take their breathing, accent, breves, macrons or letters from its headwords (see the README). Not published with this dataset; the SHA-256 is that of the list of the 27 files' SHA-256s, one line "<sha256>  <name>" per file, names in code point order, and bytes is their total size.

scans.description: University of Toronto (Robarts) copy of the 1901 printing, digitized by the Internet Archive, 300 ppi. Lacks pp. 854-855 (leaves 876-877 repeat pp. 852-853) and pp. 1383-1384.
scans.credit: University of Toronto copy, digitized by the Internet Archive (not in copyright)

leaf_files.description: Leaves and their order in archive.org's viewer (scandata.xml, a member of the item's scandata.zip, md5 918e032b679ef9e42b3264b4b99cdf5e) and archive.org's page labels (page numbers), as archive.org serves them; stored gzip-compressed under scans/, the SHA-256 and size are of the uncompressed file. A leaf is the printed page plus the offset of its range; it must be a leaf the viewer shows and carry the page's label. The labels are not used to find leaves: leaves 876-877 are labelled pp. 854-855 but repeat pp. 852-853 (pages.lacks). The viewer link uses the leaf's position among the shown leaves (n), which is the leaf number less one in this item.

scans.description: Undated American Book Company issue of the same corrected text, printed from the 1901 setting of type; supplies the ten pages the Toronto leaves can't be cut for (pp. 549, 563, 569, 651, 690, 747, 854, 855, 1627, 1683). Leaves are PDF pages.
scans.credit: American Book Company issue (Internet Archive lending library, no public image)
